full_judgment: 6. Mr. Abdur Rob Chowdhury, learned Counsel, appearing for the respondent No. 1 submitted that refusal of the appellants to allow one step out of turn promotion to the respondent No. 1 as Assistant Engineer in the PDB is contrary to the circular/officer order dated 11-8-1966 and that the aforesaid circular/ office order remained in force even after promulgation of Power Development Board (Employees) Service Rules, 1982, hereinafter referred to as the Service Rules came into effect and in this connection he has referred to Memo Nos. ঢাবিবিক/পরি(প্রশা:)/শা-৭/১.০১/২০০০/১৪০৬ dated 25-9-2000 and ঢাবিবিক/পরি(প্রশা:)/শা-৭/৭৪.০১/২০০০/১৫৫৬ dated 20-12-2000 (Annexure-K and K1) indicating that the appellants allowed the facilities to writ-petitioner in Writ Petition No. 323 of 1999 and others even after the coming into force for 1982 Rules. The learned Counsel further submitted that the statement made in the affidavit-in-opposition is that the respondent obtained decree of AMIE/BSc Engineers without permission is not correct. He again refers to Annexure-F, office order dated 10-9-1989 and submitted that even long after 1982 AKM Mohiuddin and 6(six) other Sub-Assistant Engineers have been promoted as Assistant Engineers on obtaining degree of BSc Engineering/AIME on the basis of circular dated 11-8-1966 Mr. Chowdhury further submitted that what was the necessity of purportedly adopting a regulation on 14-12-1992 to stop the facilities allowed by a circular dated 11-8-1966 but taking clue therefrom the learned Counsel submitted that the aforesaid regulation (Annexure-B) indicates clearly that at least till 20-12-2000 it was effective.
